def test_odd_count():
    # Basic cases
    assert odd_count(['1234567']) == ["the number of odd elements 4n the str4ng 4 of the 4nput."]
    assert odd_count(['3', "11111111"]) == [
        "the number of odd elements 1n the str1ng 1 of the 1nput.",
        "the number of odd elements 8n the str8ng 8 of the 8nput."
    ]

    # All even digits -> zero odd elements
    assert odd_count(['2468']) == ["the number of odd elements 0n the str0ng 0 of the 0nput."]

    # All odd digits
    assert odd_count(['13579']) == ["the number of odd elements 5n the str5ng 5 of the 5nput."]

    # Empty string -> zero odd elements
    assert odd_count(['']) == ["the number of odd elements 0n the str0ng 0 of the 0nput."]

    # Empty input list
    assert odd_count([]) == []

    # Multiple strings with mixed digit parities
    assert odd_count(['123', '456', '789']) == [
        "the number of odd elements 2n the str2ng 2 of the 2nput.",
        "the number of odd elements 0n the str0ng 0 of the 0nput.",
        "the number of odd elements 2n the str2ng 2 of the 2nput."
    ]

    # Single odd digit string
    assert odd_count(['7']) == ["the number of odd elements 1n the str1ng 1 of the 1nput."]

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_odd_count()

def test_odd_count():

    # Test with multiple strings
    assert odd_count(['3', '11111111']) == [
        "the number of odd elements 1n the str1ng 1 of the 1nput.",
        "the number of odd elements 8n the str8ng 8 of the 8nput."
    ]

    assert odd_count(['2468']) == ["the number of odd elements 0n the str0ng 0 of the 0nput."]

    # Test with string containing only odd digits
    assert odd_count(['13579']) == ["the number of odd elements 5n the str5ng 5 of the 5nput."]

    # Test with empty list
    assert odd_count([]) == []

    # Test with empty string in list
    assert odd_count(['']) == ["the number of odd elements 0n the str0ng 0 of the 0nput."]

    # Test with single digit strings
    assert odd_count(['0', '1', '2', '9']) == [
        "the number of odd elements 0n the str0ng 0 of the 0nput.",

        "the number of odd elements 3n the str3ng 3 of the 3nput.",
        "the number of odd elements 2n the str2ng 2 of the 2nput."
    ]

    # Test result is a list

    assert isinstance(result, list)
